Terra claimed to be the officer on day one, named Luna, and Luna turned out to be a killer, so the town voted her out. Haiku spent day two going after Terra, got a key detail wrong, and was voted out as a citizen. Sol then claimed to be the officer only after Terra named him, and Terra's claim held up while his did not. Sonnet, the doctor, kept Terra alive through the nights, and on day three Palermo voted out Sol, the last killer. The town won, with Terra, the officer, calling it right.
